760110101.text: #Oh! It's {NICKNAME} and Paimon! Nice to see you again!

760110102.text: Um... Miss Priestess, have we met somewhere before? You don't seem that familiar to Paimon...

760110127.text: Hey! It's me! Seriously, we met not long ago... Can't you recognize me by my voice?

760110128.text: Oh yeah, it's you! You're the one from back when— Uhh... Wait, who are you exactly? This is starting to sound like some kinda weird scam...

760110130.text: Aww, my adorable little Paimon didn't even recognize me... That really stings. But I'll let it slide — after all, you did call me "Miss Priestess." I guess it's fair, since I never took off my helmet back at Thunderclap Reef...

760110129.text: Wait, hang on! Don't tell Paimon... you're Verna!? You're really, actually a priestess from the Frostmoon Scions!?

760110103.text: E—Excuse you! That's a weird way to say hello! Seriously, you won't find a priestess more reliable than me anywhere else! There was never any reason to doubt me in the first place!

760110104.text: Ahem! Anyway, this must be the Moon Mai{RUBY#[D]Kuutar}den's guidance at work — how else could I be so fortunate as to run into you both at a time like this?

760110106.text: Exactly! That's what we call fate. "With her silver spindle, she weaves paths as one, whether they be of the rich, or the—" Uh, or the...

760110109.text: #Anyway, let's forget about all that. {NICKNAME}, Paimon, you remember what that imposter said before, right?

760110110.text: You mean that priestess-looking lady who seemed more legit than you? She said she'd be waiting at the Court of the First Edict... or something like that?

760110111.text: Ahem... That "more legit than you" bit was totally uncalled for. But since you've got such a good memory, Paimon, and since you're both going to help me out later, I'll let it slide!

760110112.text: Hey! Paimon hasn't agreed to help you out yet! Why is it that every time we talk to you, we end up second-guessing reality...?

760110113.text: Uh, don't sweat the details! More importantly, I've already come up with a flawless, super-ultra reliable plan. We'll catch that imposter in no time!

760110114.text: Think about it. She said she'd be waiting in the sealed-off sanctum no one can even get into, right? So obviously...

760110115.text: She wants us to get curious and break the seal, letting her sneak in and snatch whatever treasure's inside!

760110116.text: And my super-foolproof plan is to turn the tables on her! Once we open the gates of the sanctum, she'll definitely show up, and that's when we'll catch her!

760110117.text: Pretty solid plan, right? I'd say it'd hold up just fine against those top-notch detectives from Papa Wrench's books!

760110118.text: Seriously?! That sounds even crazier than the plan you had at Thunderclap Reef! You just told us no one's been able to unseal the Court of the First Edict for centuries!

760110119.text: Only because they didn't have me, along with the super reliable tag-team combination that is the two of you!

760110120.text: After we parted ways, I've been thinking... Since the Court of the First Edict was sealed by kuuvahki, maybe we can disrupt it the same way we did at Thunderclap Reef...

760110121.text: And so— Ta-dah! See? I had my little Krakas look for more of those special fragments, and I pieced them all together!

760110122.text: And the moment I managed to distract Eveliina, bam! You two showed up! Tell me we're not fated to reunite!

760110123.text: Fated? More like fatal! Are you sure this won't mess up the weather on Hiisi Island like it did back at Thunderclap Reef?

760110124.text: No worries! This time, I'll be in full control of the kuuvahki. And besides, everything turned out just fine back at the Reef, didn't it?

760110125.text: #Now then! {NICKNAME}, Paimon, prepare to witness the miracle of science!

760110126.text: W—Wait! If someone's gotta throw it, let us do it! If we leave it to you, this already sketchy plan's bound to get even sketchier...

760110108.text: Now now, bad feelings have no place in the Moon Goddess's guidance! Since we're all here, this must surely be a good omen... no, a great omen!

subQuests.subQuestName: Throw fragment(s) to open the sealed sanctum

760110201.text: Hehe, just like I predicted! See? As long as we follow the guidance of the Moon Goddess, everything'll fall right into place!

760110202.text: Well, if you say so... But are we really sure it's a good idea to open up a place that's been sealed for centuries?

760110203.text: Oh, it'll be totally fine! You've got the most trustworthy priestess of the Frostmoon Scions right here, there's absolutely nothing to worry abou—

760110204.text: Krodo! Did you see where those suspicious intruders were headed?

760110205.text: They took off toward the Court of the First Edict. Not many places to hide around here, after all.

760110206.text: Hmph. You two, check on the seal. I'll inform the Lady Moonchanter. Let's see them try getting away...

760110207.text: Causing trouble in the sacred lands of the Frost Moon... They've got a death wish! The only way they're getting out of this in one piece is if they're somehow the Lady Kuu{RUBY#[D]Moon Maiden}tar herself...

760110208.text: Uhh... Verna? Still wanna tell us "there's absolutely nothing to worry about"?

760110209.text: I... Uhh... Ahaha! Yep! That's right! There's absolutely nothing to worry about! Now that the seal's been opened, all we have to do is set a trap and wait for that imposter to walk right into our hands...

760110210.text: #...I'm sorry, I'm so sorry! There's absolutely everything to worry about! I should never have messed with the seal... What do we do now?! Help me, {NICKNAME}, please! *sobs*...

760110212.text: Exactly! Well, since the seal's already broken, we might as well head in and take a look... But Verna, you'd better remember to say sorry to everyone in the Frostmoon Scions when we're done here!

760110214.text: Well, since the seal's already broken, we might as well head in and take a look... But Verna, you'd better make sure to say sorry to everyone you dragged into this!

760110301.text: Umm... Verna, where are we? This doesn't really look like a sanctum...

760110302.text: Yeah, it really doesn't... Ahem! I mean, that's not important! Don't worry! This place has things that resemble Moonlanes, so that means the Moon Maiden is still guiding us... p—probably!

760110303.text: Let us follow the path illuminated by the moonlight, and leave the rest to the will of the moon.

760110304.text: That actually sounded pretty priestess-y coming from you, Verna... Wait, no! Isn't that just a fancy way of saying "I don't know what to do, let's just leave it to fate"?!

760110305.text: Hey! What do you mean "pretty priestess-y"? Have you ever met a priestess who's anything less than super priestess-y?

760110306.text: You've gotta have as much faith in the Moon Maiden's guidance as you do in the power of science! Besides, it's not like we've found any other way down...

760110401.text: Come on, I told you there's nothing to worry about! See? This is the power of science!

760110402.text: #Hurray! The power of scien— Hey, wait a second! You almost had Paimon fooled! This has nothing to do with science! It was just {NICKNAME} tossing the fragments up there!

760110403.text: #Well, since the super reliable {NICKNAME} is also someone who believes in science, I guess that explanation works too.

760110404.text: Alright! "Since the Moon Ma{RUBY#[D]Kuutar}iden has spun a silvery path for us, what awaits beyond the threshold must be..." Umm... wait, how did the rest of it go again...?

760110405.text: Ahem, anyway... since the Moonlane has appeared, it means our plan is working fine. All we need to do is follow it. This is the guidance of the Moon Goddess... Yep!

760110406.text: A—Are you sure? Paimon thinks there's a good chance this path doesn't lead to our destination, but rather somewhere higher up...

760110407.text: Come on, Paimon, come on! You've got a super reliable priestess and a super reliable adventurer on your side — what's there to worry about?

760110408.text: We'd better get moving, before the other priestesses show up— Ahem, I mean, while the Moon Goddess is still showing us the way! Onward and upward!

760110501.text: Hmm? It's awfully quiet... Ehrnrooth and Uncle Krodo aren't here either. Weren't they hot on our trail?

760110502.text: Maybe all the noise we made earlier got their attention, and they ran off to check somewhere else?

760110503.text: #Aha, I get it now! This must be Lady Aila's divine guidance. Even my luck's looking up now that I'm with someone as reliable as you, {NICKNAME}!

760110504.text: Okay, okay, save the celebration for later! You do remember you still owe everybody else an apology for the trouble you caused, right?

760110505.text: Apology? ... Ahem, r—right, yes, of course I do! I'm not the type to get so caught up in reading Lady Aila's records that I forget everything else!

760110506.text: I swear by my mortal name in this sublunary sphere that I'll give everybody a proper and heartfelt apology! It's just... Uh, I'll need to think carefully about how to phrase it first...

760110507.text: Oh! And while we were at work earlier, I came up with a super scientific plan!

760110508.text: Since I have to apologize anyway, why don't we finish checking out the sanctum first before looking for Lady Lauma? That way, we can save time and make my eventual apology more efficient!

760110509.text: A sound plan, I should say.

760110510.text: See? The power of science is— wait, huh!? Aunt Rahetar? When did you get here?

760110511.text: Waaah, you scared us! Umm... We didn't mean to sneak into the Court of the First Edict! It's just... Verna said...

760110512.text: No need to explain. This place may be sealed, but it is not forbidden territory. If outsiders like you were able to enter, then perhaps it was the will of the moonlight.

760110513.text: Exactly! This is all part of the Moon M{RUBY#[D]Kuutar}aiden's sacred guidance! Just like the poems say—

760110514.text: As for you, Vernadska, you're coming with me. The Lady Moonchanter wants to see you — in person.

760110515.text: Huh!? Wait, no, Aunt Rahetar, didn't you just say—

760110516.text: As a priestess, you acted without permission, broke the rules, and tampered with taboos. Aside from outright murder, you've flouted every major law we have.

760110517.text: Now come. Or would you rather the Lady Moonchanter come fetch you herself?

760110518.text: #Uhh... {NICKNAME}, Paimon! I'll explain everything later! I swear! But first, I—I'll need—

760110519.text: Before Verna can finish her sentence, Rahetar drags her off...

760110522.text: Well... She sure dug that grave nice and deep for herself, didn't she?

760110523.text: Still, we've got no idea what this Lady Aila wanted us to do. But this sword she left behind...

760110524.text: Uh... If it was meant for us, we might as well hang onto it for now. Looks like a real Frostmoon relic, anyway.

760110601.text: Hmm, something about this place feels off compared to what Paimon imagined a sanctum would be... It doesn't feel all that sacred. Smells kinda funny instead...

760110602.text: Haha, well, it has been sealed for 500 years, y'know? Scientifically speaking, rusted metal giving off a blood-like smell isn't too surprising.

760110603.text: By the way, the hymns say that before Lady Aila sealed it, this was where all the Frostmoon followers held their ceremonies! So it's super sacred, really!

760110604.text: Calling it "super sacred" just makes it sound less sacred by the minute!

760110605.text: Oh, come on, don't get hung up on the wording! Look over there — that's the Verdant Crest! Legend says it's the sacred tree that witnessed the birth of the Moon Mai{RUBY#[D]Kuutar}den!

760110606.text: And that pool over there... Uh, if I'm guessing right, that should be the ever-flowing White S{RUBY#[D]Vellamo}pring, blessed by Lady Aila herself!

760110607.text: Do you really have to guess? Also, are you sure you didn't just make those names up?

760110608.text: Hey! I might be a fairly reliable priestess, but even I've never seen these sacred relics from five hundred years ago with my own eyes!

760110609.text: #Nor did I ever think I'd get to see something this historically significant... I'm so lucky. All thanks to you, {NICKNAME} and Paimon!

760110612.text: #Yes, yes, no problem! I'll do whatever you say, {NICKNAME}!

760110613.text: Just standing in place does feel like a waste, though... Since we're here, why not take a quick walk around?

760110701.text: Hmm? There's something beneath the water. Is that a sword?

760110702.text: Huh? Why would there be a sword here? ...Wait. Hold on. Could this be the ritual sword forged from Hyperborean moonlight that Lady Aila supposedly left behind...!?

760110703.text: The blade that was used to offer up the very first drop of blood under the new moon... Whoa!

760110704.text: I—It's a kuuhenki... Hmm, does it want us to follow it?

760110801.text: Ah, you're here. Wait, that will get the altar dirty...

760110802.text: Eek! When the heck did you get in here? We were the ones who opened the seal first... right?

760110804.text: You're right... But this isn't just "off." It looks like this is a residual image left behind by the Moon Goddes{RUBY#[D]kuuvahki}s's blessing...

760110810.text: And it's been left inside the Court of the First Edict... Maybe this... might be the first Moonchanter herself, Lady Aila...

760110806.text: Yeah, you're right... Wait, now's not the time for that! So... just who are you, Miss Priestess-y-Looking Priestess?

760110807.text: If I may, I suspect she's more of a "what" than a "who" by now...

760110808.text: Eek! Don't say creepy stuff like that all of a sudden! Are you saying she's a...

760110809.text: No, no! That's not what I meant! There's no such thing as ghosts... At least, I think so...? But she seems more like a lingering image left behind by the Moon Goddes{RUBY#[D]kuuvahki}s's blessing...

subQuests.subQuestName: Enter the Court of the First Edict

760111002.text: Maybe all the noise we made earlier got their attention, and they ran off to check somewhere else?

760111013.text: Exactly! This is all part of the Moon M{RUBY#[D]Kuutar}aiden's sacred guidance! Look, Aunt Rahetar, we even found something Lady Aila left for—

760111014.text: As for you, Vernadska, you're coming with me. The Lady Moonchanter wants to see you — in person.

760111015.text: Huh!? Wait, no, Aunt Rahetar, didn't you just say—

760111016.text: As a priestess, you acted without permission, broke the rules, and tampered with taboos. Aside from outright murder, you've flouted every major law we have.

760111017.text: Now come. Or would you rather the Lady Moonchanter come fetch you herself?

760111018.text: #Uhh... {NICKNAME}, Paimon! I'll explain everything later! I swear! But first, I—I'll need—

760111019.text: Before Verna can finish her sentence, Rahetar drags her off...

760111022.text: Well... She sure dug that grave nice and deep for herself, didn't she?

760111023.text: But since we've already taken down the undying serpent, I suppose that means we've fulfilled the task the first Moonchanter entrusted to us, right?

760111101.text: #Hmm... this must be the sword Aila was talking about, right? How about it, {NICKNAME}? Did you figure anything out?

760111105.text: Ugh, looks like we really will have to investigate this whole place, huh? But if we hang around too long, Ehrnrooth, Uncle Krodo, and the others might find the entrance too...

760111106.text: Actually, with all the noise we made just now, there's probably no one on this whole island who hasn't been drawn this way...

760111107.text: Ugh, fine, guess we've got no choice... We've got the sword now, and Lady Aila didn't exactly tell us what to do next. Let's get out of here first and figure out the rest later!

760111104.text: #Eek! {NICKNAME}, what's happening— Hang on! Your acting is terrible! You can't start laughing halfway through your own prank! And quit scaring Paimon at a time like this!

subQuests.subQuestName: Exit the Court of the First Edict

760110901.text: Hmm, this must be the sword Aila was talking about, right?

760110902.text: Yes, yes! This is the sacred blade the first Moonchanter used to offer the very first drop of silver blood to the New Moon — a truly blessed sword of purity!

760110903.text: Ugh, I really want to investigate this place thoroughly... But if we hang around too long, Ehrnrooth, Uncle Krodo, and the others might find the entrance too...

760110904.text: Actually, with all the noise we made just now, there's probably no one on this whole island who hasn't been drawn this way...

760110905.text: Ugh, well... Since we've got the sword and the seal's already broken, I'll just have to find another time to study it properly!

760112801.text: Oh right, do you remember when Verna mentioned a place called the Court of the First Edict, when we were back at Thunderclap Reef?

760112802.text: Paimon thinks it's somewhere over on Hiisi Island. If we've got some time to spare, why not go back and have a look?
